notes.content:

Air Combat MF
We plan to set the price at $2 or $3. The development date has not been determined.
There are radio conversation dialogues during the mission.
If you like it, add it to your wish list.
Thanks.

notes.title: Included the mp3 files
notes.content:
I put in-game music in the game folder as mp3 files.(8 files)
This music was composed by using commercial licensed sound loops. Please enjoy at ease.

Right-click the game name in STEAM app.
Click "Manage".
Click "Browse Local Files".
The mp3 file is displayed.
